title: Polish has no articles
description: Why there is no word for a, an or the, and what to do about it.

blocks.text: Polish has no articles: there are no separate words for a, an or the. A bare noun can therefore mean a cat or the cat, and the meaning comes from the situation. When you translate into English, choose a, an or the from the context.

blocks.note: There is no word for a. The ending of kota changes because it is the object of the verb; that is a later topic.
It could also mean A cat is sleeping, depending on the situation.
